plan: Baseline: tests (11) and acceptance (8) all pass.
Contracts: low_stock consumes items() only; tested copy semantics, no mutation (qa/test_qa.py).
Edge cases: non-str SKUs, None/float/bool qty, tabs/newlines, huge ints, thresholds 0/negative/equal, empty inventory, zero then re-add.

gaps: Concurrency is a non-goal and was not tested.
Unicode case-folding in .upper() (e.g. 'ß' becomes 'SS') follows the spec literally and was not asserted.

advisory.problem: AC-003 only tries invalid quantities on a SKU that already has stock. The brief says to validate before changing any state, but no test checks that an invalid qty on remove of an unknown SKU raises ValueError and not InsufficientStock. The criterion's own action list does not require this.
advisory.evidence: An implementation that checks stock before validating qty would pass every test here. Only remove('B', 0) on an unknown SKU would expose it.

advisory.problem: AC-004 does not check that InsufficientStock is distinct from ValueError. A swapped exception hierarchy would still pass.
advisory.evidence: class InsufficientStock(ValueError) passes all tests. The brief does not forbid this.
